phone-title.text: Phone: iOS, follows the system appearance. Current · proposed light · proposed dark

n-main.text: Hub. Follows the system appearance. A glasses status card leads (connection, firmware and battery as words plus symbols). Rows use text styles and 44pt targets. The lime accent is retuned to deep olive in light mode.

n-navigation.text: Navigation (MapKit panel). The current column is rebuilt from MapKitNavigationUI.m because shoot.sh 'nav' captures a different HUD sample. Proposed: keep the map-first layout. Only search and travel mode stay on top. Simulate/Live moves into the ⋯ menu. The bottom card becomes a standard sheet with a grabber, a green lens preview and a glasses pill. Start is primary, Apple Maps secondary, and End appears only while navigating. Fonts move from systemFontOfSize to text styles, and the ~22 hard-coded strings go through TIOText.

n-music.text: Music. Removes the duplicated Client ID rows and moves 'Copy callback diagnostics' to Developer. Adds a now-playing card with a lyric preview. Spotify setup moves below the everyday controls.

n-captions.text: Live captions. No preview fixture exists yet, so the current column is empty. Proposed: a transcript card shows source and translation together, status is a pill (symbol plus word), and settings are standard value rows.

n-firmware.text: Firmware wizard. Today the title is dark-on-dark and unreadable because dark mode is forced. Proposed: a summary pill counts the blockers, inline fixes meet 44pt, and the disabled Continue says why it is disabled.

n-tiles.text: Menu layout. The same status sentence was repeated under three actions. Proposed: a live lens preview of the menu, one status pill, and real buttons (Save is primary; Read and Restore are secondary).

n-knob.text: Knob calibration. The actions were plain rows. Proposed: numbered steps, a large tabular result, and buttons whose set changes with state (Start, then Finish and Cancel).

n-assistant.text: Assistant and speech settings, as the reference for ordinary settings rows: values trail, toggles use the accent, and section tiles keep their colors in both themes.

glasses-title.text: Glasses: 540×180 at 2×. Orange bands are design-time guides (toggle in Tweaks)

n-lensnav.text: Navigation. The arrow, distance and turn move to band B. The road being passed goes to T and trip detail to M. ETA joins the M line, and the clock footer is removed. The map stays in the right column, anchored to the bottom.

n-lensmusic.text: Lyrics. The current line is lowest and brightest, the next line sits above it, and the previous line is dropped. The 144px art becomes a 36px ambient tile. The permanent control line becomes a 3 s transient hint.

n-lensmenu.text: Menu (540×220). Status goes to T in lens-mid, and the 'Turbo IO' wordmark is removed. The focus ring becomes brightness plus a caret, and the focused name shows once, in band B.

n-lensfocus.text: Pomodoro. A 48px hero timer in B, a hairline track and session count in T, and the next break in M. The footer hint becomes transient.

n-lensreader.text: Reader is the exception to one primary item: running text fills M and B at 20px. Position and chapter are ambient in T.

n-lensride.text: Ride. The arrival time and plate, the two things you check at the curb, go in band B. The car description goes in M and the trip state in T.

n-lensenglish.text: English. The word and its meaning go in B, the example sentence in M, and the deck position in T.

n-lensapp.text: TAP1 mini-app (commute.json). The 'Details' and 'Exit' buttons are replaced by a focus list with a caret, and Exit is gone because a long press exits. When a page has a primary readout, actions sit in M.

n-lensvoice.text: Voice. The question goes in M and the answer in B. This matches the stock 'ASR on top, answer below' layout, now with intensity steps.

n-lenscaptions.text: Captions. The translation goes in B and the source line in M, using stock caption position 'bottom' rather than 'center'. The language pair is in T.
